title: 'Pinoy Big Brother' warns against unauthorized AI content featuring housemates
summary: ABS-CBN's long-running reality show "Pinoy Big Brother" (PBB) has released a public official statement against the unauthorized use of AI-generated materials of the "PBB: Collab 3.0" housemates.
